content.value: A Fresnel bi-prism having an angle of 1° and refractive index 1.61 forms interference fringes (10) on a screen placed 80cm from the prism. If the distance between the source and bi-prism is 20cm, find the fringe separation when the wavelength of light used is (i) 6800Å and (ii) 5890Å.
